feeds.description: TM for Women offers transcendental meditation courses especially for women - addressing issues of health, education, professional and personal development, and mother-baby care.

Twenty Minutes Meditation is run by Chris Greathead, a highly skilled, professional TM teacher with over 40 years experience who helped thousands of people improve their lives through meditation.

feeds.title: Transcendental Meditation Blog
feeds.description: The TM Blog brings together personal stories, media coverage, and the latest research on the Transcendental Meditation technique.

feeds.title: India TM Blog
feeds.description: His Holiness Maharishi Mahesh Yogi established the Spiritual Regeneration Movement (SRM) Foundation in 1959 to provide in a systematized manner the technique of Transcendental Meditation so every person could enliven their consciousness and derive benefits in all aspects of life.

feeds.title: Maharishi Purusha
feeds.description: Latest news from the NextGen Purusha crew. NextGen Purusha (NGP) is for the next generation of younger men who are practicing the Transcendental Meditation (TM) and TM-Sidhi programmes and looking to discover and live their full potential via deep meditation, profound knowledge and the best experiences of their lives.
